article_title: New 10p coin enters circulation - will you spot one?

tasks.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
options: New 10p coins featuring King Charles III and an endangered Scottish bird are entering circulation
The Royal Mint is removing every 10p coin from shops
A Scottish bird charity has replaced cash with digital payments
Collectors have discovered that old 10p coins have no value
tasks.correct_answer: New 10p coins featuring King Charles III and an endangered Scottish bird are entering circulation
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה עוסקת במטבעות 10 פני חדשים הנכנסים למחזור ועליהם דיוקן המלך צ'רלס השלישי ושכווי ענק המצוי בסכנת הכחדה.

tasks.prompt: Why are newly minted 10p coins being released now?
options: Every older coin has become damaged
Collectors asked for a coin made only of silver
There is sufficient demand for more 10p coins
The government has changed the value of 10p
tasks.correct_answer: There is sufficient demand for more 10p coins
tasks.explanation_hebrew: לפי הכתבה, הביקוש למטבעות 10 פני היה מספיק כדי להצדיק הנפקה חדשה.

tasks.prompt: What appears on the reverse, or tails side, of the new coin?
options: An oak leaf
A capercaillie
A red squirrel
An Atlantic salmon
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בצד האחורי של המטבע מופיע capercaillie — שכווי ענק החי באזור קטן בסקוטלנד.

tasks.prompt: How many 10p coins dated 2023 and 2026 are entering circulation in total?
options: About 600,000
About 2.4 million
About 24 million
Just over seven million
tasks.explanation_hebrew: ה־Royal Mint מסר כי 600 אלף מטבעות מתאריך 2023 ועוד 6.5 מיליון מתאריך 2026 נכנסים למחזור — יחד מעט יותר משבעה מיליון.

tasks.prompt: What does “circulation” mean when the article says the coins are entering circulation?
options: Being used by the public as money
Being displayed only inside a museum
Being melted to make new metal
Being sold only to professional collectors
tasks.correct_answer: Being used by the public as money
tasks.explanation_hebrew: בהקשר זה circulation הוא המחזור הכספי — המטבעות מתחילים לשמש את הציבור בתשלומים ובעודף.

tasks.prompt: Why is the coin described as a “stark reminder” about the capercaillie?
options: The coin proves that the bird has disappeared everywhere
The design makes the coin difficult to use
The large number of coins contrasts sharply with the small number of birds left in the wild
The portrait shows that the King owns the remaining birds
tasks.correct_answer: The large number of coins contrasts sharply with the small number of birds left in the wild
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי stark reminder מדגיש ניגוד חד ומדאיג: יהיו במחזור יותר מטבעות עם דמות הציפור מאשר פרטים שלה שנותרו בטבע.

tasks.prompt: Give two details that make the new 10p coin historically or visually distinctive.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין שני פרטים קונקרטיים מן הכתבה על העיצוב או על משמעות ההנפקה.
expected_points: It is the first circulating 10p denomination to bear King Charles III's portrait
The design belongs to a collection inspired by British flora and fauna

tasks.prompt: Why might both ordinary shoppers and seasoned collectors look carefully at their change?
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר כיצד נדירות יחסית, עיצוב חדש ומשמעות היסטורית עשויים לעורר עניין.
expected_points: The design is newly entering everyday circulation
It is the first 10p with the King's portrait
King Charles III coins still form only a small share of UK circulating coins
Collectors may value the date, portrait or new reverse design
Shoppers can find the coins at banks, Post Offices, tills or in ordinary change

tasks.prompt: Summarise the release of the new 10p coin and the conservation message behind its design.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב סיכום קצר באנגלית הכולל את ההנפקה, שני צדי המטבע והמסר הסביבתי.
expected_points: Just over seven million 10p coins dated 2023 and 2026 are entering circulation
The obverse bears King Charles III's portrait
The bird is found in a small part of Scotland and is threatened with extinction
The design highlights conservation and the flora and fauna of the British Isles

tasks.prompt: Write a short notice encouraging people to check their change, using two accurate details from the article.
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לנסח הודעה קצרה וברורה באנגלית הכוללת קריאה לפעולה ושני פרטים מדויקים מן הכתבה.
expected_points: Tell readers to look for a new 10p coin
Mention the capercaillie on the reverse
Explain that the bird is endangered or at risk of extinction
Mention that the coins are being distributed nationwide
